subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: The Minotaur in the Maze
description: Learn The Minotaur in the Maze in one minute.

hook.text: A bull's head on a man's body, trapped in a labyrinth. The Minotaur ate human sacrifices. Shame made monstrous.

buildup.text: King Minos hid his wife's monstrous son underground. The labyrinth concealed a family scandal from the world.

discovery.text: Theseus entered the maze, killed the Minotaur, and followed Ariadne's thread back out. Courage plus strategy.

twist.text: The Minotaur never chose its nature. It was born wrong and imprisoned for it. The monster is also a victim.

climax.text: The Minotaur represents the monstrous thing we hide at our center. The labyrinth is denial. The thread is truth.

punchline.text: Kill the monster. Or admit it's you.

quiz.question: What did Ariadne give Theseus to navigate the labyrinth?
